question: azariah-11 is recorded with more than one father: jeroham-6, obed-5.

actions.why: The Hebrew separately names Azariah son of Jeroham (עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יְרֹחָם) and Azariah son of Obed (עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־עֹובֵד). The record azariah-11 represents the latter, whose father is Obed.

note: The verse lists two distinct men named Azariah. The other three relationship rows correctly distinguish their fathers.
